title: THE HOTEL ROOM NEXT DOOR
subtitle: 3-Minute American Drama Screenplay | Romance • Infidelity • Betrayal • Suspense
setting: Manhattan, New York City. A luxurious five-star hotel on a rainy Friday night.
plot_secret: Ethan is cheating with Jenna. Brian is cheating with Chloe. Neither pair knows the other is having an affair.

1: You know what's crazy? Brian thinks I'm in Philadelphia.
And Chloe thinks I'm meeting investors in Chicago.
casual bravado as he glances at phone
2: Brian, what if Ethan finds out?
Ethan trusts me with his life.
Then stop thinking about your husband for one night.
I'm serious. Jenna was asking questions yesterday.
Wait. I bought Jenna that exact bag.
sudden recognition, blood draining from face
3: Brian? What the hell are you doing with my wife?
I could ask you the same question about mine!
Explain what? That you came to a hotel with my best friend?
You told me you were in Chicago!
And you told me you were visiting your mother!
Don't turn this around on me!
You're standing here with my best friend!
You sat at my dinner table last Sunday. You looked me in the eye!
You borrowed my car yesterday to take my wife out!
desperate shout, face wet with tears
All four of us are liars! Nobody here is innocent!
You told me we'd only been doing this for three.
So while I was cheating on my wife, my wife was cheating on me... with my best friend.
4: I got the same message this afternoon. That's why I asked you to come here.
Someone booked our room under my name.
I think Ethan is cheating with someone.
Jenna in tears and Chloe listening, concealed old conversation
Then we need to teach him a lesson.
ominous calm as she takes Jenna's hand
Six months ago? But you said your affair started three months ago.
Because after you watch it... you'll know who destroyed both marriages.
It was never supposed to go this far.
mysterious male voice from television, no person face visible
